Also we can mock dependencies using Mockito (allowed?). Since we just need to generate test code, we can assume we have Mockito and JUnit 4.

protected String getNodeFieldType()
protected void preloadJsonSchemas(Collection<JsonSchema> schemas)
protected PathType getPathType()
protected String atRoot()
protected String atPath(String currentPath, String token)
protected String atPath(String currentPath, int index)

Also debug method just logs; we can test that it doesn't throw.

checkDiscriminatorMatch etc. static protected methods; test behaviors with null discriminatorPropertyValue, mapping present, explicit mapping, implicit mapping, no explicit mapping overrides.

}

But there may be NullPointer exceptions if used later.
